profile: Opus Genetics develops gene therapies for inherited retinal diseases and other therapies for ophthalmic disorders. Its pipeline includes adeno-associated virus programs targeting genetic causes of retinal degeneration, including LCA5 and BEST1-related conditions. The company is also advancing phentolamine ophthalmic solution, which is approved for pharmacologically induced mydriasis and is being evaluated for additional eye-related indications. Its gene therapies are administered by subretinal injection.
